caribbean.headline: Caribbean Conditions: St. Maarten
caribbean.paragraph: St. Maarten in the Eastern Caribbean is the highest-impact location in the Caribbean this period, with winds peaking at 19 kt and seas building to 4.4 ft with E swell at 7s periods. 75% rain probability -- expect disrupted conditions for shore excursions and tender operations.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Haifa
mediterranean.paragraph: Haifa in the Eastern Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with winds peaking at 15 kt and seas building to 4.7 ft with WNW swell at 6s periods. 50% rain probability -- isolated showers possible but conditions remain manageable.
